 Advertisement Mark your calendars: Key dates for 2026 midterm elections in Florida
 Andres Rey Close up of election day marked on calendar with usa flag SOURCE: Andres Rey Advertisement Updated: 2:45 PM EDT Oct 21, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Tyler Watkins Digital Content Producer Mark your calendars: Key dates for 2026 midterm elections in Florida
 Updated: 2:45 PM EDT Oct 21, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Tyler Watkins Digital Content Producer Election Day is right around the corner, and Florida voters should mark these key dates on their calendars.
 Deadline to request that ballot be mailed : October 22, 2026
 Early voting period (mandatory period): October 24 – 31, 2026
(Contact your county's Supervisor of Elections for optional days of early voting)
 Election Day: November 3, 2026
